excerpt_i18n.zh: 过去一年，“Agent”这个词从实验室走进了生产环境。工程师们开始真正面对一个新的问题：不是“AI 能不能做到”，而是“我们能不能把它跑稳、跑对、跑出规模”。架构怎么设计？记忆怎么管理？多智能体之间如何协调？研发团队的工作方式又该如何重构？
excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, the term "Agent" has moved from the lab into production environments. Engineers have begun to truly confront a new question: not "Can AI do it?" but "Can we run it stably, correctly, and at scale?" How should the architecture be designed? How should memory be managed? How should multiple agents coordinate with each other? And how should the R&D team's workflow be restructured?
excerpt_i18n.es: El año pasado, el término "Agente" pasó del laboratorio al entorno de producción. Los ingenieros comenzaron a enfrentarse realmente a un nuevo problema: no es "si la IA puede hacerlo", sino "si podemos hacer que funcione de manera estable, correcta y a escala". ¿Cómo diseñar la arquitectura? ¿Cómo gestionar la memoria? ¿Cómo coordinar entre múltiples agentes? ¿Y cómo debería reestructurarse la forma de trabajar del equipo de I+D?

items.title: AI and the Great CMS Unbundling
items.raw_excerpt: AI is not killing the CMS. It is unbundling creation from control. That may replace the CMS for simple publishing, but it makes the CMS more important wherever content is shared, reused, approved, or trusted across systems.

title_i18n.en: AI and the Great CMS Unbundling
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能与大CMS解绑
title_i18n.es: La IA y el gran desagregamiento del CMS

excerpt_i18n.en: AI is not killing the CMS. It is unbundling creation from control. That may replace the CMS for simple publishing, but it makes the CMS more important wherever content is shared, reused, approved, or trusted across systems.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 人工智能并未扼杀内容管理系统，而是将创作与控制分离。这可能会取代简单发布场景下的CMS，但在内容需要跨系统共享、复用、审批或信任的场景中，CMS反而变得更加重要。
excerpt_i18n.es: La IA no está matando al CMS. Está separando la creación del control. Esto puede reemplazar al CMS para la publicación simple, pero hace que el CMS sea más importante allí donde el contenido se comparte, reutiliza, aprueba o se confía en él a través de sistemas.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is now generally available: Go from idea to production-grade agent in minutes
items.raw_excerpt: Today, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is generally available. Two API calls (CreateHarness to define an agent, and InvokeHarness to run it), and you have an agent running in seconds. The agent runs in its own isolated environment with a filesystem and shell, so it can read files, run commands, and write code safely. It remembers users and conversations across sessions, picks up skills you point it at (including the AWS-curated catalog), browses the web, calls your tools through gateway or MCP, and switches model providers mid-session without losing context. Every step streams back to you in real time and is automatically traced to Amazon CloudWatch. You don’t need to write orchestration code or build a container, unless you want to.

title_i18n.en: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is now generally available: Go from idea to production-grade agent in minutes

It remembers users and conversations across sessions, picks up skills you point it at (including the AWS-curated catalog), browses the web, calls your tools through gateway or MCP, and switches model providers mid-session without losing context. Every step streams back to you in real time and is automatically traced to Amazon CloudWatch. You don’t need to write orchestration code or build a container, unless you want to.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 今天，Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 工具集正式上线。通过两次 API 调用（CreateHarness 定义代理，InvokeHarness 运行代理），即可在数秒内启动一个代理。该代理在其独立的隔离环境中运行。
excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy, el arnés AgentCore de Amazon Bedrock está disponible de forma general. Dos llamadas a la API (CreateHarness para definir un agente e InvokeHarness para ejecutarlo) y tendrás un agente funcionando en segundos. El agente se ejecuta en su propio entorno aislado.
